== Ingredients ==
*2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Flour|self-raising flour]], [[Cookbook:Sifter|sifted]]
*¼ cup skim [[Cookbook:Milk|milk powder]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Green onion|spring onions]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] ground [[Cookbook:Nutmeg|nutmeg]] 
*¾ cup cold cooked [[Cookbook:Pumpkin|pumpkin]] 
*½ cup [[Cookbook:Buttermilk|buttermilk]] 
*½ cup natural mineral water 
*[[Cookbook:Cottage Cheese|Cottage cheese]] or [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], for serving (optional)

== Procedure ==
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 220°C (430°F). 
# Combine the flour, milk powder, onion and nutmeg.
# [[Cookbook:Folding|Fold]] in the pumpkin, buttermilk and mineral water to make the [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]]. 
# Pat out the mixture onto a lightly floured board and [[Cookbook:Dough#Rolling|roll out]] to a thickness of about ⅝ [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]]. 
# Using a 2-inch scone cutter, press out 12 rounds.
# Place these on a lightly floured [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking tray]] and [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] at 220°C for 12–15 minutes or until golden. 
# Serve with dollops of cottage cheese or butter.
